# ChIPsim

## Role

ChIPsim is a Bioconductor framework for simulation of ChIP-seq experiments. It
can generate features, derive read-density profiles, sample read start sites,
and export reads. Its worked introduction demonstrates nucleosome positioning
and describes extension to TF-binding experiments.

## simitall Position

`simulate_chipseq()` connects simulated genome annotations to peak truth,
matched inputs, reads, and evaluation figures. ChIPsim is an optional backend
and a reference for realistic read-density mechanics.

## Guardrails

Feature density, fragment length, background reads, and read depth each affect
peak-call performance. Record all four in the truth metadata.
